what: The Card Maker creates greeting cards and invitations in your browser. Choose an occasion and a headline and message are filled in for you, ready to change. Invitations also get date, place and RSVP lines.

Pick a decoration (confetti, balloons, flowers, stars, hearts, an elegant frame or plain), one of seven colour sets and a headline font from elegant script to big and bold. Add a photo in a circle or as the background.

Download a PNG sized for phones and social apps, or a PDF for printing at 5 × 7 in, A5 or 7 × 5 in. On phones you can share the card straight to a chat app. Default wording is neutral, so it suits any culture or faith, and you can write your own.
uses: Send a bright card on WhatsApp or print one to give by hand.
Share the date, place and RSVP in one picture.
Make an elegant invite or save-the-date with the couple's names.
Thank teachers, guests or customers with a personal note.
Write your own greeting for any celebration.
Announce a new baby or celebrate an anniversary with a photo.
tutorial: Tap the occasion. The headline, message and a matching look are filled in.
Change the headline and message, and add who it is to and from.
For party invites and weddings, fill in the date and time, place and RSVP.
Pick a decoration, colour set and headline font. Press "Shuffle decorations" for a new arrangement.
Choose a photo and show it in a circle or as the background with a dark overlay so the text stays readable.
Pick Square or Story for sharing, or a print size, then press Download PNG or Download PDF.
features: Birthday, invitations, wedding, thank you, congratulations, festive, new baby, anniversary and get well.
Confetti, balloons, flowers, stars, hearts, frame or plain.
Light and dark palettes that work for print and screens.
Script, handwritten, casual, display, serif and sans.
In a circle or as a full background.
PNG for apps, PDF for printing, and a Share button on phones.

example.title: Worked example: a birthday party invitation
example.text: Ana taps Party invite, changes the headline to "Leo is turning 7!", writes "Come and celebrate with games and cake", and adds "Saturday 14 June, 4 pm", "Garden Hall, 5 Park Road" and "Ana, +34 600 000 000". She picks Balloons and the pink colour set, chooses Square and taps Share to send it to the parents' group chat.

tips: Keep the message short so it stays large and easy to read on phones.
For printing, choose 5 × 7 in or A5 and print at 100% scale on card.
With a background photo, choose a busy-free picture so the words stand out.
Use "Shuffle decorations" until the confetti or stars sit nicely around your text.
Write greetings in any language. The decorative fonts only have Latin letters, so other alphabets and emoji are written in Noto Sans instead.
problems: My text is not in the font I picked
The decorative fonts only have Latin letters. Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, emoji and other letters are written in Noto Sans so they always show.
Text shrinks to fit the card. Shorten the message or choose the Story size for more room.
Sharing pictures is only available in some phone browsers. Use Download PNG and send the file.
